claims.statement: EBITDA margin target of 10% to 10.5% reiterated
Capex guidance of INR 100 crores for FY25
Gross margin improved 310 bps YoY and 40 bps QoQ in Q4 FY24
Consumer Durables EBITDA margin at 3% in Q4 FY24, target pre-COVID levels of 6-7%
In-house manufacturing at 65%, targeting 75% in next 12-18 months as new factories scale
Battery and kitchen appliance factories commenced commercial production; benefits expected in FY25
TPW fan factory in Hyderabad to be completed in 18-24 months for premium TPW manufacturing
Sunflame revenue grew 28.3% YoY in Q4 FY24; integration progressing with focus on e-commerce and South
Revenue growth target of 13-15% and EBITDA margin of 9-10% for FY25
Gross margin improved 380 bps YoY to 36.3% due to pricing, softening inputs, better mix; recovery largely complete
Capex of INR100-120 crore per year for next two years; fans plant building started, completion in ~18 months
Sunflame revenue declined 7% YoY, in line with forecasts; kitchen industry facing subdued demand
Expect to repay Sunflame acquisition loan in full by end of FY25
Electronics segment expected to grow 12-14% annually
Employee cost growth expected to normalize at 13-14% annually
Capex plan of approximately INR100 crores per year for next 2 years
Gross margin improved 200 bps YoY to 35.8% in Q2 FY25
EBITDA margin improved 30 bps YoY to 8.5% in Q2 FY25
Copper price volatility caused 0.6% company-level margin impact in Electricals
Gross margin still 1-1.5% below pre-COVID levels on like-to-like basis
Battery factory newly commissioned; Stabilizer and Inverter factory online for 15-18 months
Current in-sourced manufacturing at 65%, outsourced at 35%
Non-South market grew 15.8% YoY contributing 48.4% of total revenues; South market grew 3.7% YoY
Gross margin improved to 36.2% in Q3 FY25 from 33.7% a year ago (+250 bps) driven by in-house manufacturing share, cost savings and premium mix
EBITDA margin was 8.2% in Q3 FY25, down 50 bps YoY due to higher A&P spends (especially Sunflame) and employee cost reversals in base quarter
Board approved ~INR100 cr investment in VCPL Hyderabad facility for TPW and ceiling fans, to be spent over 3 years (INR50 cr in year 1) funded by internal accruals
New Hyderabad fan plant first phase expected to start commercial production in 18 months; Roorkee liquid-painted fan capacity constrained, powder-coating has spare capacity
Targeting ~10% EBITDA margin (currently ~8-9%); gap with market leaders narrowed from 4-5% to 1-2% over 5 years
Further margin improvement scope in Consumer Durables (kitchen Vapi plant, new fan plant) as Electronics benefits largely realized; aim to restore CD margins to pre-COVID levels
Board approved Rs 50 crore investment to expand Battery plant capacity in Hyderabad
Management targets 14-15% top-line growth and consistent EBITDA margin expansion for FY26 despite weak summer in South India
Gross margin improved 100 bps YoY to 35.5% in Q4 FY25; recovery largely complete driven by in-house manufacturing, cost efficiency, and premium mix
Solar rooftop business growing very strong within Electronics segment; expected to hit significant scale in 4-5 years with headroom across 35 states
Annual capex around ₹100 crores; no major increase expected; major part going to moulds; Vapi kitchen plant not at full capacity
Hyderabad battery plant at full utilization; new capacity expansion of ₹50 crores to add ₹300-400 crores throughput; full stabilization in 2.5 years
Expect demand to normalise in coming quarters and continue to invest in brand building and capacity enhancement
Revenue growth target for FY26 revised to 11-13% from earlier 14-15% due to weak Q1
EBITDA margin guidance for FY26 set at 8.5-9.5%
Gross margin at 36.7% in Q1 FY26 vs 36.6% YoY, up 110 bps sequentially from Q4 FY25
EBITDA margin declined to 8.4% in Q1 FY26 from 10.5% YoY due to operating deleverage
Electronics segment sustainable margin around 17%, not 18-19%
Fan factory under development, operational in 18 months; Battery unit expansion in 24 months
In-house manufacturing currently at 65%, targeting increase via new Fan and Battery plants
Expect improvement in demand to start reflecting in coming quarters post GST 2.0 reforms
Gross margin improved 140 bps YoY to 37.6% in Q2 FY26; EBITDA margin declined 40 bps YoY to 8.1%
EBITDA excluding other income was INR109 crore, down 1% YoY; EBITDA margin 8.1% vs 8.5% in Q2 FY25
Management withdrew 15% FY26 revenue growth guidance; will reassess after Q3
Capex guidance INR120-130 crore each for FY26 and FY27; for R&D centre, Fan factory, Battery factory, moulds and dies
Battery manufacturing Phase 1 at 40-50% of sales; plan to reach 70-80% in 2 years
Electronics segment normative EBITDA margin 17-18%
Wire gross margin improved due to copper price increases; selling lower-cost inventory at higher prices
Sunflame EBITDA margin target 12% in 2-3 years from current depressed levels
Gross margin improvement largely done; further delta will be very less
EBITDA margin target 9.5-10% for FY27 assuming decent top line growth
Consumer Durables margin target 5-6% in 2-3 years from current ~1%; Fans largest category needing improvement
Gross margin contracted 100 bps YoY to 35.7% due to mix impact; margins remain resilient
EBITDA margin expanded 60 bps YoY to 8.8%; EBITDA grew 18.3% YoY to INR 123 crore
Company plans calibrated pricing actions across portfolio in coming quarter due to input cost increases
Fan manufacturing facility and second battery facility in Hyderabad are key pipeline projects to increase in-house manufacturing share
Sunflame gross margins held; pricing transmission not a challenge; stress from delayed product refresh cycle (18 months)
Expect better profitability in FY27 vs FY26 due to better summer contribution and operating leverage, unless commodity prices violently spike further
Target double-digit EBITDA margins by FY27 if raw material inflation normalizes and growth returns
Solar Pumps business started with first order of INR 4-5 crore from Maharashtra government; targeting meaningful scale-up in 12-18 months
Electronics Rs 26.92 crore
Electricals Rs 34.92 crore
Consumer Durables Rs 50.91 crore
Sunflame Rs 5.86 crore
Total Rs 118.61 crore
Targets 10-12% volume growth and 1-2% price growth, aiming for ~15% overall growth; expects at least 10% EBITDA margin if summer is good
Solar inverter business expected to become one of the larger categories in 3-4 years, potentially matching or exceeding inverter battery business size
H2 FY26 EBITDA around 9.5%; confident of hitting double-digit EBITDA (at least 10%) if summer is good, but cost inflation from West Asia conflict is a challenge
Bulk of new capacity investments done; ramp-up underway; Lighting foray targeting early next quarter launch
FY27 revenue growth expected above 15% with 9-10% EBITDA margin
Capex guidance revised to INR150-170 crore annually for next two years
Gross margin stable at 36.9% YoY despite input cost pressures
EBITDA margin expanded to 10.5% from 8.4% YoY
Sunflame integration complete, sales acceleration program underway with improved momentum
Capex reduced to INR150-170 crore annually from earlier INR200-250 crore guidance
Capex for FY27 expected around INR 150 crore
Gross margin 34.3% in Q2 FY27 vs 37.6% YoY and 36.9% QoQ due to higher input costs and mix change
EBITDA margin 9.1% in Q2 FY27 vs 8.1% YoY; H1 EBITDA margin near 9.5-10%
Electronics segment sustainable margin 16-17% normal year, 18% in good year
Electronics segment revenue grew 60% YoY in Q2 led by Solar, Inverter & Battery; Electricals grew 41.2%; Consumer Durables grew 20%
Solar manufacturing not yet started; supply chain still forming; Gegadyne battery pilot orders may start in few months
Innovation centre set up 3-4 years ago to strengthen electronics capability and support new categories like Lighting, Solar, Batteries
